gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-zanabaz: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square reads wide and friendly, with gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp and a soaring x-height. Junegull sits above it, closed and stubby, its cast-iron lowercase giving the page a retro anchor.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-traditional-: Junegull carries a retro, friendly look, its curves staying full right through the shoulders instead of thinning out. And Noto Traditional Nushu counters with open, broad-nibbed strokes that never curl shut.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-numans: Numans spreads out with loosely tracked, swollen lowercase and an s whose ends hang far from its spine. Junegull gives it a flat, sign-painter weight to push against.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-onest: Friendly from the first glance, Junegull pinches its curves shut while Onest keeps short ascenders above big, open bowls. Shrink the heading and that closed-up character fades quickly.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-orienta: Zero stroke modulation is the giveaway: Junegull draws every curve with no swelling or thinning at all. Orienta follows with hollow, breathing counters and little gap between its cases, so paragraphs stay quietly uniform.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-oxygen: Friendly and a bit retro, Junegull draws even its g in one unbroken line weight. Oxygen is the sans-serif beneath it, with curves left open and lowercase nearly matching its capitals, which gives the pair a crisp, modern tidiness.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-parkinsans: Junegull is chunky, closed and cheerfully retro. Parkinsans runs on one stroke thickness with wide-mouthed letters, so a longer passage stays crisp and moves along easily.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-pathway-extreme: Junegull brings a retro, pinched-shut friendliness to the top of the page. Pathway Extreme then offers clear openings in its rounded letters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height, so long text feels compact yet easy.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-preahvihear: Chunky and retro, with a lowercase built like cast iron capitals and no thick-thin contrast to slow the eye. Preahvihear opens its letter mouths wide, so a smaller heading would lose that weight against its lofty x-height.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-pt-sans-caption: Retro and chunky, Junegull has no thick-thin variation, just closed shapes with a pinch at each curve. PT Sans Caption answers with unclosed, inviting bowls, a plain sans that stays friendly.
